name: Ramsar site
description: Wetland of International Importance designated under the Ramsar Convention.

name: National or natural park
description: Area designated by national law as a national, marine or natural park.

name: Community protected area
description: Protected area created and managed with or by local communities.

name: Biosphere reserve
description: Site recognised under UNESCO's Man and the Biosphere Programme.

name: World Heritage site
description: Property inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

name: Nature reserve
description: A nationally designated nature, strict nature or natural reserve.

name: Marine protected area
description: A nationally designated protected area covering marine or coastal waters.

name: Wildlife or game reserve
description: A nationally designated wildlife, faunal or game reserve, or a wildlife sanctuary.

name: Forest reserve
description: A nationally designated forest reserve or classified forest.

name: Other protected area
description: Another nationally designated protected-area category, such as a protected landscape, conservation area or protectorate.
